# unifi_mclag_domain (Data Source)

Fetches a single MC-LAG domain by id via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single MC-LAG domain by its UUID (Official API).
data "unifi_mclag_domain" "core" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the MC-LAG domain to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The full MC-LAG domain record, including nested lags and peers, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the MC-LAG domain entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The MC-LAG domain name.
